claims.statement: The classical Hodge conjecture is rational cycle-class surjectivity for smooth projective complex varieties.
Cycle-class surjectivity is equivalent to rational generation by irreducible codimension-p subvariety classes.
The cases p=0,1,n-1,n imply the full conjecture in complex dimension at most three.
The rational Hodge conjecture holds for all smooth projective complex varieties.

claim_boundary: No new algebraicity theorem or unrestricted fourfold codimension-two result is claimed.
